note: **10 Western Terrace, schedule 201 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** The Goddard family, who kept 8 Park Terrace in 1921 - Arthur Raymond the dental surgeon, his wife Ernestine, and the daughter the index calls Joan T, who is their Theodore Joan. Three of the four are bound by number.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A
